decisions.reason: As a niche extension of the firm's proven spraying business, it has clear technical fit and some public commitment, so management is likely to continue rather than reverse course quickly.
Because it is close to the established offer and was given its own web page, the firm has both strategic fit and visible commitment, which under an escalation-of-commitment logic favors retention.

A multi-model product line building on the core pump business likely required meaningful development and launch effort, so management would be especially reluctant to withdraw it after such investment.

Its dedicated market presentation and relevance to monitored, more digitalized industrial systems make it important enough that management would probably attribute any early weakness to temporary market-development factors and keep it.
